verdicts.quote: If a note is missing, I want it to be obvious — not just a blank row, but a red highlight with the patient’s name and the time it was due.

When a nurse saves a note and ShareSheet is unreachable, the nurse should see a clear message on screen... retries every 5 minutes for 30 minutes... then a contact IT message... IT team gets an alert with nurse’s name, patient ID, and time of failure.
If the nurse saves the same patient's note twice during an outage, the system should keep both copies... show both in ShareSheet with timestamps and a note 'Duplicate entry — check for accuracy.'

The status line must update in real time, without needing a refresh. If the connection comes back, the nurse should see 'Sent' appear automatically on the same screen, right after the 'Retrying' message.

At 10:15 a.m., the team leader should see a clear alert in their dashboard with nurse’s name, patient’s full name, note type, due time, all in one line, red, pinned to the top, with a direct link to the note entry page.
The alert should stay open until the sync is confirmed — even if the team leader clicks 'Marked as resolved.' If sync still fails after 5 minutes, alert reverts to red and IT is notified.
